items.text: Vikings WRs Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) both Q; will work out pregame. Jefferson determined for Louisiana homecoming.
items.implication: High chance both play but confirm warmups.
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, volume to other MIN WRs

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (foot, Q) is expected to play vs Falcons SNF.
items.implication: Start with confidence in Huntley offense.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot, no practice, Q) is not expected to play vs Broncos.
items.why: Did not practice week; Schefter Sunday report.
items.implication: Sit; offense already struggling with OL issues.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (plantar fasciitis/ankle, missed late practice) hopeful to play but not definite; will workout pregame. Elevated RB (Hemby) in case.
items.opportunity: If OUT, full workload to elevated backup

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive for Sunday vs Lions as details finalized. Texans primary team to watch.
items.why: Trade finalization; team informed morning of inactive.
items.implication: No fantasy production Week 5; ROS destination TBD (HOU interest).
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining AZ WRs

items.text: Chargers expected to start four rookies on OL (Slater/Alt out) vs DEN; Herbert 6 straight games TD passes not exceeding INTs.
items.implication: Further suppress Herbert/pass catchers (McConkey already out).

items.text: Expect a LOT of Giants RB Cam Skattebo today.
Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) expected to play vs Vikings.
Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) expected to play.
items.implication: Lock in lineups; limits Henderson upside.

items.text: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle (toe, Q) unlikely to play vs Colts; final call in pregame warmups.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for other PIT RBs

items.text: Going from Lamar Jackson to Tyler Huntley is a downgrade but for fantasy purposes it doesn't really matter much this week.
items.why: Confirmed OUT; analysis with Stephania Bell.
items.implication: Ravens pass catchers still viable but tempered.

items.text: MHJ had only 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor in any Michael Wilson usage. Post-inactive/trade it is Kendrick Bourne season.
items.why: Prior low production data; Wilson already producing independently.
items.implication: Wilson immediate upgrade in AZ offense; Bourne also rises.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets expand further without MHJ

items.text: Loves Chase Brown (RB5 vibes) as 'Brown Gobbler' for gobbling targets and fantasy points this week.
items.implication: RB2/flex with upside if Chase limited.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins as WR8 vs TEN on volume, red-zone work and matchup.
Loves Michael Wilson as WR10 vs DET on volume including red zone.
items.why: Volume + matchup; amplified by MHJ inactive.

items.text: Loves Christian Watson as WR15 vs CHI.

items.why: Tough matchup/thin role/usage numbers + injury Q.
items.implication: Sit if possible; risky even if active.
